data.title: Four-Digit Place Value Explorers
data.description: Learn how to read four-digit numbers using thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones blocks.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Remember to check the hundreds, tens, and ones places carefully, especially where there might be a zero.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Count the thousands blocks first, then the hundreds, tens, and ones.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Look at the columns. If a place has no blocks, its digit is zero.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Take it one place value column at a time from thousands down to ones.
